doors.truthFlag: status: "success"; no paging — the widget's default arguments (start 0, end 0, incldateless true) request the organization's whole upcoming list in one response
doors.note: The URL the widget builds (widget.js: /events/events_by_organization/<pid>/<oid>/<start>/<end>/<topic>/<inclcal>/<incltopic>/<incldateless>/<inclThumbnail>/<promoterId>, served from events.ticketsauce.com). Rows are an id-keyed map under $.data; each row is an envelope { Event, EventTopic, Logo, Masthead, Organization, Photo, Partner }. Event carries name, summary/details (HTML), start/end (local wall clock) with start_utc/end_utc and timezone "America/Chicago", location (the venue name), address/city/state/postal_code, latitude/longitude, thumb_url, and url (the sickening.events event page, where tickets are sold). Every row is a dated instance; the feed states no recurrence rule (LIP SERVICE KARAOKE's weekly nights are separate rows with numbered slugs).

events.title: GOLDILOXX Chicago
events.description: The Experience GOLDILOXX brings a unique nightlife experience to Chicago, blending social interaction, dancefloor energy, and unexpected connections into one unforgettable night. Upon arrival, choose a color-coded cup that reflects your vibe and connect with others throughout the evening. Choose Your Vibe Blue — Feeling Bold Pink — Flirty Energy Orange — Open to Connection Green — Taking It All In The Space Two floors. Two different vibes. Dance, mingle, connect, and explore throughout the night. The Music DJs from NYC and Chicago bringing nonstop energy from start to finish. Extras Go-Go Dancers All Night Clothing Check Available Come ready. Stay late.

events.title: LIP SERVICE KARAOKE
events.description: Lip Service: Kinky Karaoke at Jackhammer Hosted by Tim Bell Every Wednesday | 9PM Step up, take the mic, and let it out. Lip Service is Chicago's kinkiest karaoke night—where bold performances, uninhibited energy, and a packed bar come together every Wednesday at Jackhammer. Whether you're here to sing, scream, or simply watch the chaos unfold, this is your midweek release.

events.title: BEAR HAPPY HOUR
events.description: Bear Happy Hour Fourth Thursday of the Month | 6PM–10PM Bear Happy Hour is a monthly social built for bears, friends, and admirers to connect, unwind, and ease into the night. Whether you're stopping by after work or settling in for the evening, expect a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere with plenty of opportunity to meet new people and catch up with familiar faces. This is a low-pressure, high-vibe space centered on community and conversation.

events.title: Fetish Friday: GEAR
events.description: FETISH FRIDAY: GEAR Fourth Friday of the Month | 9PM–4AM GEAR is your monthly invitation to suit up and step into the scene. Dedicated to showcasing leather, rubber, harnesses, hoods, and everything in between, Fetish Friday: GEAR creates a space where expression, confidence, and community come together. Whether you're building a collection or trying your first piece, this night is about showing up, exploring, and being part of the energy. Expect a packed room, bold looks, and a crowd that understands the assignment. Dress Encouraged: Leather, rubber, harnesses, gear, or your interpretation of the theme

events.title: HIM
events.description: Him TransMasc Dance Party HIM is a TransMasc dance party presented by the TransMasc Society of Chicago, at Jackhammer and The Hole, for a night built entirely around community, music, and dancefloor energy. A stacked lineup of DJs and performers keeps the night moving from the first beat to the last. Come support the community, dance all night, and be part of a space built for and by TransMasc folks. Saturday, September 26th 9PM DJs Kaos · Avi Wavi · Daigroovie Performers Troy · Butch Dream Daddy · Andy Chaz · Devyn-Marshall Sinclair · Mak · Juniper Faewild · Penis Envy · Nasty Navi Jackhammer and The Hole. Presented by the TransMasc Society of Chicago.

events.title: FUZZED
events.description: Chicago's Premier Furry Party Get Fuzzed Get Fuzzed is Chicago's premier furry party, and it's back at Jackhammer for a night full of live energy, good music, and plenty of local furries to meet, party, and hang out with. Fursuits and furry gear are encouraged, not required, so come exactly as you are. This is a space built for community first, costume second. Sunday, September 13th 6PM to 2AM Jackhammer Chicago.
